weekly_keyword_config_snapshot.scope: Computational pathology and adjacent computational tissue, spatial and single-cell omics. Histopathology images are not required for spatial/single-cell methods or cancer multimodal omics.

include: Computational histology, cytology, tissue microscopy, slides, staining and pathology reports
Spatial transcriptomics/proteomics/multi-omics methods, resources, benchmarks and substantive tissue or disease applications
Single-cell multi-omics integration, annotation, representation learning, foundation models and cell-state or tissue mapping
Computational tissue microenvironment, spatial niches, cell-cell communication and ligand-receptor inference
Cancer multimodal omics, genomics-guided imaging, molecular prediction, missing-modality learning and survival analysis
exclude: Unrelated radiology-only methods with no tissue, molecular or cancer multi-omics contribution
General protein/drug/molecular sequence models without a tissue, spatial, single-cell or cancer-omics contribution
Wet-lab-only studies without a computational method/resource or substantive spatial/single-cell tissue analysis
Editorials, comments, retracted papers, unrelated meanings of pathology/spatial/cell and duplicate versions
